# Provider SVG provenance

The 30 SVG components in `components/modals/provider-icons.tsx` preserve the geometry, titles, colors, gradients and currentColor behavior of the previously installed `@lobehub/icons@5.10.0` (MIT), from https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons. Only the React wrapper was replaced; gradient IDs remain unique for every mounted instance. Brand marks remain property of their respective owners.
